title: Low-Autocorrelation Binary Sequences (LABS)
summary: Exact integer-energy verification and structured search against audited 2016–2026 LABS constructions at 160 lengths, every witness rechecked by two separately coded checkers; five exact-checked record candidates (N=108, 118, 119, 463, 485) await independent novelty review.

credit.policy: Credit original witness authors per row; credit contributors and AI assistance in result packages and CONTRIBUTORS.md. No authorship promise.

review.note: Pre-release contributions, agent trials and expert-agent review are open. Douglas Colkitt (@Mister-Meeseeks) coordinates the incubated project as maintainer from 2026-10-22; review capacity is surge. Scientific acceptance requires review: results are author-checked (both exact checkers were written by the same author), and independent arithmetic, parent-provenance and novelty review of the five pending record candidates, plus a renewed literature audit for each length, are wanted before any frontier update. No fixed review throughput or completed expert signoff is implied. See PARTICIPATION.md.

requirements.note: Python >=3.10; C++17 and make for solver. No GPU or external Python packages.
